# petal-elements

> Community-maintained Material 3 Expressive web components (Lit custom
> elements), continued from material-web. Tags are `petal-*`, classes
> `Petal*`, CSS custom properties `--md-*`. Sizes, colors and motion follow
> Jetpack Compose Material 3. Works in plain HTML and any framework. Not an
> official Google project.

Docs ship in the package under `docs/` (`node_modules/petal-elements/docs/`).
Each component page has usage, accessibility, Compose behavior, theming tokens
and, at the end, an API section with tables of properties (and their
attributes), methods, events and slots. Read the page of every component you
use before writing markup; do not guess attribute or slot names.

## Setup

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:opsz,wght,FILL,GRAD@20..48,400,0..1,0&display=block">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="node_modules/petal-elements/tokens/css/sys.css">
<style>
  :root { color-scheme: light dark; --md-ref-typeface-brand: Roboto; --md-ref-typeface-plain: Roboto; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--md-sys-color-surface); color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface); font: var(--md-sys-typescale-body-large); }
  :not(:defined) { visibility: hidden; }
</style>
<script type="module">
  import 'petal-elements/button/filled-button.js'; // one import per component used
</script>
```

- `npm install petal-elements`; bare imports work with any bundler. Without a
  bundler, map `petal-elements/` and `lit` with an import map (see
  docs/quick-start.md), or import `petal-elements/all.js` for everything.
- `sys.css` defines all `--md-sys-*` / `--md-ref-*` tokens; colors use
  `light-dark()`, so set `color-scheme` on `:root`.
- `<petal-icon>name</petal-icon>` shows a Material Symbols icon by name; an
  `<svg>` works instead.
- Own text: `font: var(--md-sys-typescale-<display|headline|title|body|label>-<large|medium|small>)`.

## Rules

- Use only attributes, slots and events listed in the component's doc.
  Content goes in named slots (`slot="headline"`, `slot="icon"`, ...).
- Name icon-only controls with `aria-label`; give fields a `label`.
- `petal-*-button` and `petal-icon-button` submit their `<form>` by default;
  add `type="button"` for script-only buttons.
- Form controls (text fields, selects, checkbox, radio, switch, slider, date
  and time pickers) are form-associated: use `name`, `value`, `required` and
  `new FormData(form)` as with native inputs.
- Style through `--md-*` custom properties (each doc's *Theming* section) and
  `--md-sys-*` tokens; do not pierce shadow DOM; do not add transitions or
  animations to components (they move on springs by themselves).
- Layout: navigation bar under 600px wide, navigation rail from 600px
  (expanded from 840px), FAB fixed 16px from the bottom end.
- Do not set `role`/`aria-*` to change a component's role: they are moved to
  the inner element at runtime (`data-role`, `data-aria-*` on the host).

## Guides

- [Building pages](docs/building-pages.md): page setup, colors and surfaces, responsive app shell (bar, rail, drawer), FAB placement, settings / form / dialog / search / list-detail screens, an events table, frameworks (React, Vue, Angular), rules
- [Motion](docs/motion.md): motion schemes, the six springs as CSS (`--md-sys-motion-spring-<fast|default|slow>-<spatial|effects>` + `-duration`), what each component animates, mouse hover previews, `transitionTheme()`, View Transitions, reduced motion
- [Using in an existing site](docs/migrating.md): from material-web (`md-` to `petal-`), from hand-written components (mapping table), things that surprise people
- [Quick start](docs/quick-start.md): CDN, install, import, build
- [Material 3 Expressive features](docs/expressive.md): button sizes and shapes, toggle buttons, button groups, filled FABs
- [Theming](docs/theming/README.md), [color](docs/theming/color.md) (incl. generating a scheme from one color), [typography](docs/theming/typography.md), [shape](docs/theming/shape.md), [tokens](docs/tokens.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md), [support and browsers](docs/support.md)

## Components

Format: doc — import path(s) — tags — key attributes; slots; events.

### Actions

- [Button](docs/components/button.md) — `button/{filled,filled-tonal,outlined,elevated,text}-button.js` — `petal-filled-button` etc. — `size` (xsmall…xlarge), `shape` (round|square), `toggle`, `selected`, `trailing-icon`, `href`, `type` (submit|button|reset), `disabled`, `soft-disabled`; slots: default label, `icon`; events: `click`, `change` (toggle)
- [Icon button](docs/components/icon-button.md) — `iconbutton/{icon,filled-icon,filled-tonal-icon,outlined-icon}-button.js` — `petal-icon-button` etc. — `size`, `width` (narrow|default|wide), `shape`, `toggle`, `selected`, `href`, `icon-motion`, `flip-icon-in-rtl`, `aria-label-selected`; slots: default icon, `selected`, `badge`; events: `click`, `change`
- [Button group](docs/components/button-group.md) — `buttongroup/button-group.js` — `petal-button-group` — `size`, `connected`, `single-select`; slot: buttons (toggle buttons for selection)
- [Split button](docs/components/split-button.md) — `splitbutton/split-button.js` — `petal-split-button` — `variant` (filled|tonal|elevated|outlined), `size`, `checked`, `trailing-label`; slots: default label, `icon`, `trailing-icon`; events: `click` (main action), `change` (menu toggle; anchor a `petal-menu` to it)
- [Segmented button](docs/components/segmented-button.md) — `segmentedbutton/{segmented-button-set,segmented-button}.js` — `petal-segmented-button-set` (`multiselect`), `petal-segmented-button` (`label`, `selected`, `icon` slot); event: `segmented-button-set-selection` (`detail.index`, `detail.selected`)
- [FAB](docs/components/fab.md) — `fab/fab.js`, `fab/branded-fab.js` — `petal-fab` — `variant` (primary|secondary|tertiary|surface|filled-primary|filled-secondary|filled-tertiary), `size` (small|baseline|medium|large), `label` (extended), `expanded`, `lowered`, `follow-pointer`; slot: `icon`
- [FAB menu](docs/components/fab-menu.md) — `fabmenu/{fab-menu,fab-menu-item,toggle-fab}.js` — `petal-fab-menu` (`expanded`, `items-label`; slots: items, `button`), `petal-fab-menu-item` (default label, `icon`), `petal-toggle-fab` (`checked`; `icon`, `checked-icon`)
- [Floating toolbar](docs/components/floating-toolbar.md) — `floatingtoolbar/floating-toolbar.js` — `petal-floating-toolbar` — `orientation`, `expanded`, `colors` (standard|vibrant), `fab-position`; slots: default, `leading`, `trailing`, `fab`
- [Chips](docs/components/chip.md) — `chips/{assist,filter,input,suggestion}-chip.js`, `chips/chip-set.js` — `petal-chip-set` > `petal-assist-chip` | `petal-filter-chip` | `petal-input-chip` | `petal-suggestion-chip` — `label`, `elevated`, `selected` and `removable` (filter), `href`; slot: `icon`; events: `click`, `remove` (cancelable)

### Navigation

- [Top app bar](docs/components/top-app-bar.md) — `appbar/top-app-bar.js` — `petal-top-app-bar` — `headline`, `subtitle`, `size` (small|medium|large), `centered`, `heading-level`, `scroll-target`; slots: `navigation`, `actions`, `headline`, `subtitle`, `collapsed-headline`, `collapsed-subtitle`; sticks to the top, collapses on scroll
- [Bottom app bar](docs/components/bottom-app-bar.md) — `appbar/bottom-app-bar.js` — `petal-bottom-app-bar` — `flexible`, `hide-on-scroll`, `scroll-target`; slots: default actions, `fab`; event: `hide-change`
- [Navigation bar](docs/components/navigation-bar.md) — `navigationbar/{navigation-bar,navigation-bar-item}.js` — `petal-navigation-bar` (`selected-index`; event `change`) > `petal-navigation-bar-item` (`selected`, `href`, `icon-position`; slots: default label, `icon`, `selected-icon`, `badge`); 64px, position it yourself
- [Navigation rail](docs/components/navigation-rail.md) — `navigationrail/{navigation-rail,navigation-rail-item}.js` — `petal-navigation-rail` (`expanded`, `selected-index`; slots: items, `header`; event `change`) > `petal-navigation-rail-item` (as bar items)
- [Navigation drawer](docs/components/navigation-drawer.md) — `navigationdrawer/{navigation-drawer,navigation-drawer-item}.js` — `petal-navigation-drawer` (`type` modal|dismissible|standard, `open`; `show()`, `close()`; events `change`, `open`, `opened`, `close`, `closed`) > `petal-navigation-drawer-item` (slots: label, `icon`, `selected-icon`, `badge` = trailing count)
- [Tabs](docs/components/tabs.md) — `tabs/{tabs,primary-tab,secondary-tab}.js` — `petal-tabs` (`active-tab-index`, `scrollable`, `auto-activate`; event `change`) > `petal-primary-tab` | `petal-secondary-tab` (`active`, `inline-icon`; slots: label, `icon`); show the panels yourself
- [Search](docs/components/search.md) — `search/search-bar.js` — `petal-search-bar` — `value`, `placeholder`, `layout` (full-screen|docked), `expanded`; slots: default results (e.g. a `petal-list`), `leading`, `trailing`; events: `input`, `search` (Enter), `open`, `close`

### Containment and overlays

- [Card](docs/components/card.md) — `card/{filled,elevated,outlined}-card.js` — `petal-filled-card` etc. — `clickable`, `href`, `target`, `disabled`, `dragged`; slot: content (no padding); give clickable cards an `aria-label`
- [Carousel](docs/components/carousel.md) — `carousel/carousel.js` — `petal-carousel` — `variant` (multi-browse|uncontained|hero), `item-width`, `item-spacing`; children are the items; height 221px by default; `scrollToItem(i)`, `currentIndex`
- [Dialog](docs/components/dialog.md) — `dialog/dialog.js` — `petal-dialog` — `open`, `type="alert"`, `quick`; slots: `icon`, `headline`, `content` (a `<form method="dialog">`), `actions`; `show()`, `close()`, `returnValue`; events: `open`, `opened`, `close` (cancelable), `closed`, `cancel`
- [Bottom sheet](docs/components/bottom-sheet.md) — `sheet/bottom-sheet.js`, `sheet/standard-bottom-sheet.js` — `petal-bottom-sheet` (modal; `open`, `skip-partially-expanded`; `show()`, `close()`, `expand()`) and `petal-standard-bottom-sheet` (docked; `value` partially-expanded|expanded|hidden, `peek-height`, `hideable`; event `change`); slots: content, `drag-handle`
- [Menu](docs/components/menu.md) — `menu/{menu,menu-item,sub-menu,menu-group}.js` — `petal-menu` (`anchor` = id, `open`, `positioning` absolute|fixed|document|popover, `anchor-corner`, `menu-corner`, `single-radio`; events `opening`, `opened`, `closing`, `closed`, `close-menu`) > `petal-menu-item` (`type` menuitem|menuitemcheckbox|menuitemradio, `checked`, `keep-open`, `href`, `disabled`; slots: `headline`, `supporting-text`, `start`, `end`), `petal-sub-menu` (slots `item`, `menu`), `petal-menu-group`
- [Tooltip](docs/components/tooltip.md) — `tooltip/tooltip.js`, `tooltip/rich-tooltip.js` — `petal-tooltip` (`for` = anchor id; text) and `petal-rich-tooltip` (`for`, `persistent`, `caret`; slots: text, `title`, `action`)
- [Snackbar](docs/components/snackbar.md) — `snackbar/snackbar.js` — `petal-snackbar` — message text, `action`, `dismissible`, `duration`, `action-on-new-line`; `await show()` resolves `action` | `timeout` | `dismiss` | `close`
- [Badge](docs/components/badge.md) — `badge/badge.js` — `petal-badge` (`value`; empty = dot) in the `badge` slot of an icon button or navigation item
- [Divider](docs/components/divider.md) — `divider/divider.js` — `petal-divider` (`inset`, `inset-start`, `inset-end`)

### Lists

- [List](docs/components/list.md) — `list/list.js`, `list/list-item.js` — `petal-list` (`segmented`) > `petal-list-item` (`type` text|button|link, `href`, `selected`, `three-line`; slots: default/`headline`, `overline`, `supporting-text`, `trailing-supporting-text`, `start`, `end`)

### Inputs

- [Text field](docs/components/text-field.md) — `textfield/{filled,outlined}-text-field.js` — `petal-filled-text-field`, `petal-outlined-text-field` — `label`, `value`, `type` (text|email|number|password|search|tel|url|textarea|…), `required`, `error`, `error-text`, `supporting-text`, `prefix-text`, `suffix-text`, `placeholder`, `readonly`, `maxlength`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `pattern`, `autocomplete`, `rows`; slots: `leading-icon`, `trailing-icon`; events: `input`, `change`
- [Select](docs/components/select.md) — `select/{filled,outlined}-select.js`, `select/select-option.js` — `petal-outlined-select` > `petal-select-option` (`value`, `selected`; slot `headline`) — `label`, `value`, `required`, `error`, `error-text`, `supporting-text`; slots: options, `leading-icon`; events: `change`, `input`
- [Checkbox](docs/components/checkbox.md) — `checkbox/checkbox.js` — `petal-checkbox` — `checked`, `indeterminate`, `name`, `value`, `required`; event `change`; wrap in `<label>`
- [Radio](docs/components/radio.md) — `radio/radio.js` — `petal-radio` — `name` (group), `value`, `checked`; event `change`
- [Switch](docs/components/switch.md) — `switch/switch.js` — `petal-switch` — `selected`, `icons`, `show-only-selected-icon`, `name`, `value`; event `change`
- [Slider](docs/components/slider.md) — `slider/slider.js` — `petal-slider` — `min`, `max`, `step`, `value`, `ticks`, `labeled`, `value-label`, `range` with `value-start`/`value-end`; events `input` (drag), `change` (release)
- [Date picker](docs/components/date-picker.md) — `datepicker/{date-picker,date-picker-dialog}.js` — `petal-date-picker` (inline) and `petal-date-picker-dialog` (`show()`) — `value` (ISO `2026-10-21`), `min`, `max`, `locale`, `display-mode` (picker|input), `isDateSelectable`; event `change` (dialog: on OK)
- [Time picker](docs/components/time-picker.md) — `timepicker/{time-picker,time-picker-dialog}.js` — `petal-time-picker`, `petal-time-picker-dialog` — `value` (`HH:MM`, 24 h), `hour-cycle` (12|24), `locale`, `display-mode` (picker|input), `layout`; event `change`

### Feedback

- [Progress](docs/components/progress.md) — `progress/{linear,circular}-progress.js` — `petal-linear-progress`, `petal-circular-progress` — `value` (0–`max`, default max 1), `indeterminate`, `wavy`, `buffer` (linear), `four-color`, `animate-value`
- [Loading indicator](docs/components/loading-indicator.md) — `loadingindicator/loading-indicator.js` — `petal-loading-indicator` — `contained`, `value` (determinate)
- [Pull to refresh](docs/components/pull-to-refresh.md) — `pulltorefresh/pull-to-refresh.js` — `petal-pull-to-refresh` — `refreshing`, `scroll-target`; event `refresh` (set `refreshing = false` when done)

### Building blocks

- [Icon](docs/components/icon.md) — `icon/icon.js` — `petal-icon` — ligature text or `<svg>`, `filled`
- [Elevation](docs/components/elevation.md) — `elevation/elevation.js` — `petal-elevation` in a `position: relative` parent, `--md-elevation-level` 0–5
- [Focus ring](docs/components/focus-ring.md), [ripple](docs/components/ripple.md) — `focus/md-focus-ring.js` (`petal-focus-ring`), `ripple/ripple.js` (`petal-ripple`) for your own controls
- Form behaviors for your own form elements: `behaviors/*.js`

## Motion and theme APIs

- Springs as CSS: `transition: transform var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial-duration) var(--md-sys-motion-spring-default-spatial)`; standard (calmer) scheme: load `tokens/css/motion-standard.css` after `sys.css` — see docs/motion.md
- `transitionTheme(apply, event)` from `petal-elements/theme/theme-transition.js`: switch light/dark with a circle from the clicked control
- Mouse hover previews the press automatically; touch keeps Compose's look; `prefers-reduced-motion` turns movement off

## Machine-readable API

- `.d.ts` next to every `.js`; tags are declared in `HTMLElementTagNameMap`
- [custom-elements.json](custom-elements.json): a custom elements manifest. Each `petal-*` class extends a base class in an `internal/` module, and the inherited attributes, members, events and slots are on those base declarations (follow `superclass`)
